entities.name: Léonce Deprez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Léonce Deprez was a French footballer and politician. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was Mayor of Touquet-Paris-Plage from July 1969 to June 1995 and from March 2001 to March 2008.
